metadata.title: Rate-Distortion Immunology: Defragmenting the Aging Immune Repertoire
metadata.description: Theoretical and methods preprint proposing a prior-sensitive coverage-gap framework for T-cell receptor repertoires. Numerical results are synthetic only; no human cohort was analyzed. Biological interventions are not recommended. See the public GitHub archive for the source, verification code, and limitations.
